spec2def(getuname.dll getuname.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# getuname.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/getuname-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(getuname_shims OBJECT getuname.c)
target_link_libraries(getuname_shims PRIVATE libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(getuname_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(getuname getuname-cargo getuname.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS getuname_shims psdk)
